module: Continuously variable transmission (CVT) gearbox logic, modes P R N D. Loaded by vehicleController when the "gearbox" device is of type cvtGearbox. Instead of choosing a discrete gear, it sets the continuous ratio every frame (gearbox:setGearRatio) to bring the engine speed toward a target speed interpolated between cvtLowRPM and cvtHighRPM according to driving aggression, and drives a simple converter lockup (electrics.values.lockupClutchRatio).
notes: jbeam keys read in init: cvtGearRatioSmoothingIn (20), cvtGearRatioSmoothingOut (5), cvtTargetAVSmoothingIn (0.5), cvtTargetAVSmoothingOut (2), automaticModes ("PRND"), defaultAutomaticMode ("N"), cvtAggression (0.5), cvtHighRPM, cvtLowRPM (default: the highShiftUpRPM / lowShiftUpRPM shift points of gear 1), torqueConverterLockupRPM, torqueConverterLockupRange (20% of the lockup RPM), torqueConverterLockupMinGear (0).
The ratio is only adjusted if |gearbox.outputAV1| > 10 rad/s; at standstill the ratio is maxGearRatio.
The lockup is a linear ramp on engine speed (no partial lockup, unlike automaticGearbox).
There is no "whileShifting" logic: updateGearboxGFX always stays inGear of the current mode. In arcade shiftUp/shiftDown display a warning and shiftToGearIndex switches to realistic.
Gear indices are virtual: P=-2, R=-1, N=0, D=1 (cvtGearIndexLookup). currentGearIndex is 0 in P and N.

Inconsistency: an "M" or "S" mode listed in availableModes does not exist (only P R N D), the M handling code remains but is never used; applyGearboxModeRestrictions manipulates nonexistent modes 1/2.
M.throttleInput is assigned in init without being declared; M.running too (updateExposedData).
Common shiftLogic contract: gearboxHandling, timer, timerConstants, inputValues, shiftPreventionData, shiftBehavior, smoothedValues injected by vehicleController.

throttle.desc: Throttle (0..1), swapped with the brake in arcade reverse.

brake.desc: Brake (0..1), at least arcadeAutoBrakeAmount at standstill in arcade.

minGearIndex.desc: Absolute value of the smallest index (init), then not updated.

isSportModeActive.desc: True in S mode (not available in practice).

isManualModeActive.desc: True in M modes (not available in practice).

updateGearboxGFX.desc: nop then inGear of the active mode.

init.desc: Creates the gear ratio and target speed smoothers, the mode list, the lockup parameters and applies the default mode. Called by vehicleController (init and reset).

gearboxBehaviorChanged.desc: Selects the arcade or realistic logic.

areShiftLEDsInUse.desc: True outside arcade in manual mode (never in practice).

getGearName.desc: Name of the current mode (P, R, N, D).

getGearPosition.desc: Normalized lever position and mode index.

shiftUp.desc: Realistic: switches to the next mode in the list (P->R->N->D).

shiftDown.desc: Realistic: switches to the previous mode.

shiftToGearIndex.desc: Realistic: chooses the mode matching the lever position (-1 R, 0 N, 1 P, 2 D); nonexistent -> message and N.

sendTorqueData.desc: Asks the engine to send its torque curves to the UI.
